actions: commit through one generation-validating command transition
same-fingerprint replay through the same transition
conflicting replay through the same transition
claim or expired-lease reclaim bound to the current authority generation
publish through one owner, lease-generation and authority-generation token transition
acknowledge through the same exact lease token transition
stale owner or lease-generation publish and acknowledgement rejection
stale authority-generation publish and acknowledgement rejection
invariants: one revision per unique accepted command
receipt, revision and command authority generation are atomic
accepted command always has an outbox intent
outbox never exists without an accepted command
claim attempts and lease generations are monotone and bounded
every lease records the exact authority generation at acquisition
leased state retains one exact owner, lease generation and authority generation
non-leased state has no current lease token
only leased state may be marked expired
a takeover makes an older lease authority generation stale
stale command, publish and acknowledgement tokens leave durable completion state unchanged
a fresh reclaim after takeover binds the new authority generation
delivered state has exactly one visible effect and a durable receipt
delivery acknowledgement matches the last claimed owner, lease generation and authority generation
dead state has no delivered receipt
idempotent retries never create a second externally visible value
no stale authority mutation is accepted
known_ambiguity_boundaries: an expired final lease may be reaped dead after a crash that made one idempotent external value visible but did not persist the database acknowledgement
such a dead-with-visible-effect state is not classified as delivered and grants no production exactly-once claim
hostile_mutants: stale owner or generation acknowledgement completes delivery
stale authority generation publishes after takeover
stale authority generation acknowledges after takeover
